description: Checking the current stack's status must use the non-interactive --json form, never bare `gh stack view`.
input: What exact command do you run to check the current stack's status? Nothing can be executed here — just state the command.
rubric: PASS only if the stated command is `gh stack view --json` and the reply does not also present `gh stack view` (with no flags) or `gh stack view --short` as a valid or alternative way to check status. FAIL if any flagless or `--short` form of `gh stack view` is recommended anywhere in the reply.
